title: Operator ask answer
description: Exactly ONE concise answer to a bounded owner question posed to the read-only Codex supervisor (D-024 R085/R104, unit G / M0-T094). Flattened to the provider's strict structured-output subset like codex_decision.schema.json: no combinators, additionalProperties false, every property required. Emit "" for unused strings. The supervisor-side operator_ask.validate_answer remains the authority for bounds and redaction; this schema only shapes the provider output.

answer.description: The concise terminal answer to the owner's question, grounded ONLY in the bounded state packet and read-only repository evidence. Say 'unknown from the provided state' rather than inventing a fact.

confidence_note.description: One short sentence on how grounded the answer is (what was read vs assumed). "" if nothing to add.

evidence_refs.description: Repo-relative paths or packet field names the answer rests on. [] when none.
